0022600026.text: The Boston Celtics, who are 6-2 overall and have won their last game, visit the Charlotte Hornets as the 2nd team in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, and 3rd in the East, with a 1-2 road record. Charlotte is 3-6 and on a five-game losing streak, sitting 10th in the East with a 2-3 home record, and Boston will be without Jayson Tatum (rest), Devin Carter (illness) and Payton Pritchard (day-to-day, eye abrasion, a game-time decision), while Charlotte is missing Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness). The teams have not played each other yet in the 2026-27 season, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7, 2026.
